title: Adding to 10
seo_title: Adding to 10 – Kindergarten Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Put two groups together and count how many altogether; add within 10 with pictures, ten frames and a number line. (summary of the NERDC Kindergarten Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free kindergarten maths worksheets for Nigeria: add within 10 with pictures, ten frames, number lines and short stories. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Put the two groups together.
  • Count all of them, or start at the bigger number and count on.
  • 3 + 2 = 5 means 3 and 2 more make 5.

Examples

Example

4 + 3 = ?

Start at 4

Count on 3: 5, 6, 7

Answer: 7

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting the first number againStart after it: 4, then 5, 6, 7.
Taking away instead of addingPlus (+) means put together.
Forgetting some objectsTouch each one as you count.

items.q: 1 apple and 1 apple. How many apples in all?
items.e: Put them together and count all: 1, 2. There are 2 apples in all.

items.q: 1 ball and 3 balls. How many balls in all?
items.e: Put them together and count all: 1, 2, 3, 4. There are 4 balls in all.
Put them together and count all: 1, 2, 3, 4. There are 4 stars in all.
